elements.label: Statement line 1
elements.text: Powered by Agentic AI, they’re capable

pattern.description: On a soft lime-to-white gradient, a three-line centred statement builds word by word in reading order, each word fading in at its final position; the full sentence holds once complete.
pattern.why_premium: Words land in place with no layout shift, so the reader tracks a stable centred block; the steady per-word cadence (roughly 2-3 frames apart) is fast enough to feel like a single reveal yet slow enough to read along. Large, tight sans type on a quiet gradient keeps it clean.

build_hint.gsap: Split the sentence into words (SplitText type: 'words'), then tl.fromTo(words, {autoAlpha: 0}, {autoAlpha: 1, duration: 0.25, ease: 'power1.out', stagger: 0.09}); lines are pre-laid out centred so nothing reflows.
build_hint.remotion: Map words with index i: opacity = interpolate(frame - i*3, [0, 7], [0, 1], {extrapolateLeft: 'clamp', extrapolateRight: 'clamp', easing: Easing.out(Easing.quad)}); render inline-block spans in a centred fixed-layout block.

notes: Per-word diff boxes exist (b05-b17) but the 16 words exceed the 12-element cap, so lines (b02-b04) are used with text_unit word. Visible text runs ahead of the narration (line 1 is mostly shown before 'Powered' is spoken). Whether words also blur or rise slightly cannot be resolved from the filmstrip; no SFX candidates.
